# `ContentRegistry::substances`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-content">content</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **Content** (`src/plugins/content.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns every registered substance definition by stable substance id.

## Signature

```rust
fn substances (& self) -> & BTreeMap < SubstanceId , SubstanceDefinition >
```

## Arguments

This method does not take plugin-supplied arguments.

## Return Value

& BTreeMap < [`SubstanceId`](../structures/substanceid.md) , [`SubstanceDefinition`](../structures/substancedefinition.md) >
